Definition
[locally collapsing definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 13.1\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals A Ricci flow on $[0,T)$ is locally collapsing at $T$ if there are $t_k\to T$ and $B_k=B(p_k,r_k)$ at time $t_k$ with $r_k^2/t_k$ bounded, $|\Rm |(g(t_k))\le r_k^{-2}$ on $B_k$, and $r_k^{-n}\vol (B_k)\to 0$.
